$comment: One sentence per hint per tool, for the portal's justification fields. Each entry states the VALUE it justifies beside the sentence; `pnpm submission` reads the live catalogue and refuses to build if a live hint differs from the value written here, so a sentence can never justify a hint the server no longer declares. The values are owned by the server's registry (@shipstatic/mcp, one row per tool: mutation × reach); this file explains them to a reviewer and owns nothing else.

readOnlyHint.why: Creates a new deployment from the files the user provides and publishes it at a fresh URL.

openWorldHint.why: Publishes content to a publicly reachable shipstatic.com URL, which is public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Only adds a new deployment; it never overwrites or removes an existing one, and an anonymous deployment simply expires.

readOnlyHint.why: Lists the connected account's deployments and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the connected ShipStatic account and nothing beyond it; the read changes no public state.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns one deployment's details and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the connected ShipStatic account and nothing beyond it; the read changes no public state.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Replaces the labels on one of the connected account's deployments.

openWorldHint.why: Labels are private account metadata; the served site and its public URL are unchanged.

destructiveHint.why: Replaces the existing label set rather than adding to it, so a call can discard labels the user had set; the deployment and its files are untouched.

readOnlyHint.why: Removes a deployment and its files from the connected account.

openWorldHint.why: Takes a publicly reachable site offline, which changes public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Permanently deletes the deployment and its files with no recovery.

readOnlyHint.why: Creates a custom domain record or points an existing one at a different deployment in the connected account.

openWorldHint.why: Changes which site a public hostname serves once the user's DNS points at ShipStatic, which is public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Re-pointing a domain replaces what that public hostname serves rather than adding to it; the previous deployment still exists and the domain can be pointed back.

readOnlyHint.why: Lists the connected account's domains and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the connected ShipStatic account and nothing beyond it; the read changes no public state.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns one domain's details and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the connected ShipStatic account and nothing beyond it; the read changes no public state.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns the DNS records to configure at the domain's DNS provider and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads the connected account's domain record; the DNS records it returns are configured by the user elsewhere, and the read changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns the DNS provider ShipStatic recorded for the domain, if known, and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads a stored value from the connected account's domain record; nothing is looked up on call and nothing changes.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns a shareable link to the domain's DNS setup page and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Derives a link from the connected account's domain record; nothing is created and nothing changes.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Checks whether a domain name is valid and available and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Answers from ShipStatic's own records; nothing is reserved and nothing changes.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Queues a DNS verification for the domain, which can move it to verified and start serving the linked site.

openWorldHint.why: A successful verification puts the site live on the user's public hostname, which is public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Only checks DNS the user configured and activates the domain; nothing is deleted or overwritten.

readOnlyHint.why: Removes a custom domain from the connected account.

openWorldHint.why: Stops the public hostname from serving the site, which changes public internet state.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns the connected account's email, name, plan, current usage and plan caps, and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the connected ShipStatic account and nothing beyond it; the read changes no public state.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves account details only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.
